subject: Modular Demo Hub — traffic flow & collateral placement (floor plan options)
messages:
From: Rachel Lowe <rachel@brightshow.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T14:12:00Z
Subject: Modular demo hub — initial layout options and traffic flow

Hi Sofia / Marissa,

Attached are three modular-config options for the 20'x20' demo hub at Nimbus AI (Hall C). We focused on minimizing cross-traffic through the demo zone and creating a dedicated evaluation lane for longer demos. Highlights:

- Option A: Central island with two demo bays and single perimeter attendee flow (best for controlled demos).
- Option B: Staggered pods (recommended if you expect back-to-back demos; slightly higher staffing requirement).
- Option C: Corner flow with demo counter and standing area — opens sightlines to main aisle.

Notes on signage and collateral placement:
- Collateral rack on the left of the entry reduces blocking; 1x branded kiosk tablet per bay.
- Overhead hanging sign allowed (12' max) for corner sightlines; we can supply mockups.
- We recommend 2x floor mats to indicate demo queue and protect carpet near high-traffic zones.

I also included a quick traffic-flow sketch (site_map_NimbusAI_HallC_v2.png) and a sample collateral pack checklist. Let me know constraints from your equipment stack (power, AV run) and any must-have sightlines for Nimbus reps.

Cheers,

Rachel Lowe
Account Lead
BrightShow Exhibits
Attachment: BrightShow_ModularOptions_A.pdf (3 pages, layouts)
Attachment: site_map_NimbusAI_HallC_v2.png (1 image)

Rachel — thanks for the quick turn.

We're leaning toward Option B (staggered pods) because Nimbus expects a steady stream of 10–12 minute demos and we want minimal handoffs. Two quick asks before we lock:

1) Can Option B be adjusted so the demo bays have a 36" clear aisle on the demo-facing side? We need ADA clearance and room for demo carts.
2) For the overhead sign: can you show the visibility from Aisle 3 (heading north)? Nimbus CSM wants to ensure their logo reads at speed from the main corridor.
3) Confirm weight/load for the demo counters — we'll bring a portable GPU rack (~55 lbs) and a secondary monitor on stand.

Marissa — can you confirm collateral counts from the latest vendor sheet? (I'll attach the working inventory in the next mail).
Dylan — please flag any AV/power redlines we need to address with the show (power port count / dedicated circuit).

I'll schedule a 20-min call if we need to go through the options together.

Thanks,

Quick AV/power note — thanks for the details.

- Power: The GPU rack (55 lbs) + monitor + laptop per bay is fine but we need at least 2x 20A circuits for the 3-bay staggered config (one shared behind the bays, one dedicated to the wrap counter). I'll put that in the show electrical request.
- AV: Recommend adding 1x HDMI switch per bay to simplify laptop swaps (we'll bring short HDMI patch cables).
- Rigging for overhead sign: confirm that the hanging point is within 18' of the booth floor and that BrightShow will provide the certified rigging plan.
- Shipping: If we want the demo counters staged on Monday morning, deadline to inbound to show freight is Thursday prior (docs attached).

I can beta the load plan and include a cable run diagram if you want.

—Dylan
